messages:
Maya: Quick sync — Sprout pilot enrollment is live for the first cohort. Wanted to surface onboarding status and a small risk on renewal timing.
Alex: Thanks! Can you list the blockers you saw?
Maya: Two things: 1) one customer (Jordan) flagged SSO mismatch during seat invites, 2) we need a tighter cadence for collecting feature feedback (short surveys) post-demo.
Sam: For SSO mismatch, can you DM the exact error message? I can push a fix to the invite flow today.
Jordan (Sprout): quick note — our IT team saw a 401 from the idp when the invite link was accepted. I pasted the log to the support ticket (SUP-824).
OnboardBot: Ticket SUP-824 created and tagged cx:Sprout, severity:medium. Next action: engineer triage.
Sam: Got the ticket, looking now. Likely redirect URI mismatch. If someone from Sprout can confirm the app callback URL it's faster.
Maya: Jordan — can you confirm callback URL is https://app.sprouthq.com/auth/callback?
Jordan (Sprout): confirmed. I also added the metadata to SUP-824.
Alex: Re: feedback cadence — propose a 3-step micro-survey: after first login (1 Q), after first week (2 Q), and after feature deep-dive (3 Q). Short, in-app. Thoughts?
Maya: Love that. We should make the first survey trigger on user creation and send via email + in-app toaster. Keep it 1-2 questions max.
Sam: I can wire up the in-app toaster events. Anyone have preferred question text?
Maya: First-login: "Were you able to complete setup? (Yes / No)" optional text field for "If no, what blocked you?"
Alex: Week-1: "Which feature did you use most? (open)" and "Would you want a brief walkthrough? (Yes/No)"
Jordan (Sprout): Sounds good. Also can we get a weekly digest of pilot feedback — simple CSV export to share with our product team.
Maya: We'll add that to the enablement playbook. I'll set up a recurring digest: weekly on Fridays, include ticket links + survey rollups + NPS-lite.
Sam: FYI — temporary workaround for SSO: resend invite with query param ?skip_idp_check=true (internal only). Do not use in production.
Maya: Noted. We'll only use workaround for 1 customer while Sam patches.
OnboardBot: Deploy job #deploy-233 reported: invite-flow patch queued to staging.
Sam: Pushed patch to staging, running integration tests. ETA to prod ~3 hours if green.
Maya: Last thing — renewal risk: Sprout is on a 6mo pilot. If adoption <10 users active/week by month 2, flag for early expansion workshop. I'll create an action card.
Alex: I'll pair with Maya to draft the workshop agenda and POA if that flag triggers.
Jordan (Sprout): Appreciate the proactive plan — we'll aim to push to 15 active users by end of month 2, will share internal invites plan.
Maya: Perfect. I'll follow up with a short checklist and assign owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks — will update SUP-824 when patch is live.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: "Send weekly digest to Sprout" every Friday 09:00 PST starting next Friday.
Maya: Closing thread for now, will reopen if new issues.
